WITH sales AS (
  SELECT p.sku, f.sales_line_id, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.region = 'South' AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
),
rets AS (
  SELECT p.sku, r.staff.x
  FROM (SELECT 1) r, (SELECT 1) p
),
s_agg AS (
  SELECT sku,
    sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) AS net_ns,
    sum(standard_cost) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) AS cost_ns,
    sum(net_amount) AS net_all, sum(standard_cost) AS cost_all
  FROM sales GROUP BY sku
),
r_agg AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net) AS ref_net, sum(r.standard_cost_returned) AS ref_cost
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.region = 'South' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
  GROUP BY p.sku
)
SELECT 1

WITH s_agg AS (
  SELECT p.sku,
    sum(f.net_amount - f.standard_cost) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) AS margin_ns_before_ret,
    sum(f.net_amount - f.standard_cost) AS margin_all_before_ret
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.region = 'South' AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
  GROUP BY p.sku
),
r_agg AS (
  SELECT p.sku,
    sum(r.refund_net - r.standard_cost_returned) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) AS ret_margin_ns,
    sum(r.refund_net - r.standard_cost_returned) AS ret_margin_all
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE s.region = 'South' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
  GROUP BY p.sku
),
cur AS (SELECT sku, product_name, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current),
m AS (
  SELECT a.sku, c.product_name, c.category,
    a.margin_ns_before_ret - coalesce(r.ret_margin_ns,0) AS margin_ns_net,
    a.margin_ns_before_ret, a.margin_all_before_ret - coalesce(r.ret_margin_all,0) AS margin_all_net
  FROM s_agg a LEFT JOIN r_agg r USING (sku) LEFT JOIN cur c USING (sku)
)
SELECT sku, product_name, category, round(margin_ns_net,2) AS margin_ns_net, round(margin_ns_before_ret,2) AS margin_ns_before_ret, round(margin_all_net,2) AS margin_all_net,
  rank() OVER (ORDER BY margin_ns_net DESC) AS rk_ns_net, rank() OVER (ORDER BY margin_ns_before_ret DESC) AS rk_ns_gross, rank() OVER (ORDER BY margin_all_net DESC) AS rk_all_net
FROM m ORDER BY margin_ns_net DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AS after_apr1, 
  count(*) AS n,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date < p.valid_from OR f.sale_date > p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prod_version_outside_validity,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate) - f.gross_amount) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount < f.standard_cost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_cost,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.listed_from > f.sale_date OR p.delisted_on < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outside_listing
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.region = 'South' AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH s_agg AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount - f.standard_cost) AS margin_before_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.region = 'South' AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
  GROUP BY p.sku
),
r_agg AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net - r.standard_cost_returned) AS returned_margin
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE s.region = 'South' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
    AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
  GROUP BY p.sku
)
SELECT c.sku, c.product_name, c.category,
  round(a.margin_before_returns - coalesce(r.returned_margin, 0), 2) AS gross_margin_eur
FROM s_agg a
LEFT JOIN r_agg r USING (sku)
JOIN dim_product c ON c.sku = a.sku AND c.is_current
ORDER BY gross_margin_eur DESC
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
WITH south_ids AS (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND region = 'South'),
s_agg AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount - f.standard_cost) AS m
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM south_ids) AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
  GROUP BY p.sku
),
r_agg AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net - r.standard_cost_returned) AS rm
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM south_ids) AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
    AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
  GROUP BY p.sku
)
SELECT a.sku, round(a.m - coalesce(r.rm,0),2) AS margin_current_south FROM s_agg a LEFT JOIN r_agg r USING (sku) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12
